description: React component for a search page that allows users to search songs, albums, and artists. It utilizes Material-UI components and makes API calls to fetch search results based on user input.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: React functional component implementing the search interface, including input handling, search API call, and rendering results.

methods.name: doSearch
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered on form submission or Enter key press; performs API call to fetch search results based on query.
